va_powerwf.title: One PowerWF grid-impact study
va_powerwf.caption: Teaching diagram of the author-maintained PowerWF Grid Impact Evaluation example. LangGraph stores the study state; the analysis steps request PowerWorld tools. Baseline and added-load studies run in the documented order.
va_powerwf.assumptions: The internal tool-call/return routing and completion flags are simplified. No performance or deployed-utility claim is made. This is one documented PowerWF example, not a claim that every PowerAgent component uses LangGraph.
va_powerwf.credit: Original editable teaching diagram based on the cited primary source

va_dragent.title: DrAgent plans calls to domain tools
va_dragent.caption: Teaching view of DrAgent: the plan selects tools for the question. Recorded-signal tools supply measurements; manual search supplies product information. The manual path is needed only for relevant questions.
va_dragent.assumptions: This is a high-level adaptation rather than the paper’s exact graph. The two branches do not imply parallel execution or that both are required for every answer. No numerical fault result is invented.
va_dragent.credit: Original editable teaching diagram based on the cited primary source

va_simulation_feedback.title: Simulation code with an error-feedback loop
va_simulation_feedback.caption: Simplified study-generation workflow from Jia, Cui and Hug. Execution errors return to retrieval and code repair. A run without a software error still needs a check against the requested study settings.
va_simulation_feedback.assumptions: The diagram does not claim that the paper includes an automatic proof that the code meets every engineering requirement. Grading and numerical task validity remain separate from error-free MATLAB execution.
va_simulation_feedback.credit: Original editable teaching diagram based on the cited primary source

va_xgrid.title: X-GridAgent coordinates specialized services
va_xgrid.caption: Teaching view of X-GridAgent’s planner, coordinator and tool services. Eight MCP servers cover the paper’s listed functions. Pandapower supplies numerical studies; other services also read, edit and plot data.
va_xgrid.assumptions: This is an architecture summary, not the exact runtime trace. Only numerical calls are shown passing to pandapower; the illustration does not claim that all eight services are solvers or that X-GridAgent uses LangGraph.
va_xgrid.credit: Original editable teaching diagram based on the cited primary source

va_mcp.title: MCP is the connection to a callable tool
va_mcp.caption: Original teaching view of the MCP client/server connection. The application chooses a call, the client sends it to a server, and the server invokes the allowed capability. The returned result is evidence for the next step.
va_mcp.assumptions: This is a conceptual interface diagram, not a network-security guarantee or one application’s exact deployment. The application must still check permissions, arguments, case versions and the meaning of returned results.
va_mcp.credit: Original editable teaching diagram based on the cited primary source
